dataset: Seven published Organic Syntheses parent steps and eleven single-side perturbations.
design: Development set selected after inspection of the original CSV evaluation. Cases and endpoints were fixed before scoring these counterfactuals. No negative yields or experimentally failed attempts are asserted.
atom_inventory_scope: Only molecules supplied in the reaction SMILES. An element absent from every listed input cannot be supplied by changing their stoichiometric coefficients. An omitted reagent can remedy an incomplete record.

pair_endpoint.order: Compare the standard ordinal ranks only if both ranks are numeric. Higher parent = win; equal = tie; lower = reversal. Null rank on either side = abstained pair, reported separately, never imputed.
pair_endpoint.strict_separation: Report wins over all pairs and win/tie/reversal counts over comparable pairs. No credit for ties or abstentions in the all-pair strict count.
pair_endpoint.warning_endpoint: Report fraction of four missing-element controls with no positive support rank and fraction explicitly identifying that product elements lack an atom source; a generic abstention is not an element-specific warning.
pair_endpoint.specificity_endpoint: For each of seven alternate products, record rank and any exact, measured, or repeated support. A match for the alternate product under other conditions does not contradict the cited preparation.
